project_name.justification: Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV: MINK) ("MINK " or the "Company") today announced that it has acquired a 100% interest in six (6) mining claims located adjacent to its Warren North claim boundary (see Figures 1 and 2) from STLLR Gold Inc. (TSX: STLR) referred to as the "Warren Northeast" or "WNE" claims.
